cards.title: Leave {from.area} under the adjacent areas
instructions: Proceed toward the beach line and descend to 4,500' MSL before transiting under the adjacent Mustang areas
Do not breach the boundary of an adjacent Mustang area
Maintain a vigilant scan for traffic conflicts while transiting below the Mustang areas
Scan for KNWL course rules departure traffic as you intercept the Southern Arrival
cards.detail: For a practice PEL, coordinate with ATC and maintain 4,500' MSL until clear of the Mustang areas unless ATC approves otherwise.
cards.source: Binder, pp. 10–12, 24; Feb 2026 PPT, Part 1, slides 85–88.
